feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 May 2026 10:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 09 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the far west of Ireland, with a ridge to Hebrides.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northeast 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 in the west of the area at first, then decreasing Northeast 3 or 4 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning. Backing North or Northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, veering North or Northeast on Monday morning, decreasing 3 or 4 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light rain and drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle for a time.
